GTA 6 Money Making

The payout ladder: Moses, Pay ’n’ Spray, Randy’s wish list, robberies and hidden stashes.

13 sourced guides. Positions are deliberately unpinned until coordinate evidence is reliable — each guide gives the area and the source's own directions.

Selling Stolen Cars to Moses (Chapter 2)The first steady paycheck in Leonida comes one ordinary car at a time. Selling Tracked Cars at Pay 'n' Spray (Chapter 3)Once the story moves on, the spray shops start buying the cars Moses wouldn't touch. Randy's Wish List SupercarsA collector with a list of twenty-two dream cars pays life-changing money for each one — delivered spotless. Jewelry Store Smash 'n' GrabsGlass cases, a back-room safe, and a fast exit — the mid-game's bread and butter. Small Banks and Payday Loan RobberiesSmaller scores than the big vaults, but they open a chapter earlier. Large Bank Vault RobberiesThe biggest scores in the game sit behind vault doors that only open for a few minutes at a time. Kenton's Treasure DivesA dive-shop owner in the Keys pays for whatever the wrecks on the seabed are hiding. Crab Research Outpost StashAn abandoned research outpost in the swamp guards the biggest one-time cash grab of the early game. Family Savings: Protecting Cash Past Chapter 1Everything you earn early on has an expiry date — except what you tuck into one particular account. Moses' Named Jobs (Steal Vehicles for Moses)Six named shopping-list jobs pay better than random sales — and finish with a gift. Fencing Targets for 100%Completion has a price list: the checklist wants six figures of fenced goods. Robbery Targets: Stores, Smash 'n' Grabs, Gang OperationsThe repeatable robbery map is bigger than it looks — over 160 targets. $250,000 Post-Story CheatA quarter-million per use, if the report is true — at the price of your trophies.

Leonida Fieldnotes is an independent, unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Every guide is sourced from a published report and labelled with its confidence tier; nothing here is presented as personally verified in-game, and no position is pinned without reliable coordinate evidence.
